registrar_rulings.reason: No id prices this cut: chicken-breast, whole-chicken and cooked-shredded-chicken each EXCLUDE 'tender' in commodities.json (lines 20, 5206, 66494), so tenderloins are deliberately walled out of every existing chicken id rather than carried by one; the live feed's only 'tenderloin' cell is pork-tenderloin, and chicken-nuggets is a breaded frozen cooked form, i.e. a different purchase. Approve chicken-tenderloins as recipe-only (recipe-board baseline + recipe-commodities.json). Follow-ups: (1) include must be tight — e.g. chicken\s+tender(?:loin)?s?\b — with a full ~150-pattern exclude list copied from chicken-breast's rigor, and it MUST exclude breaded|battered|crispy|frozen|fully\s+cooked|nugget|popcorn|dipping|strips so breaded 'chicken tenders' SKUs cannot crown a raw-tray id; (2) add commodity-dupe-allowlist.json pairs chicken-tenderloins~chicken-breast (different cut, distinct tray SKU priced above breast) and chicken-tenderloins~pork-tenderloin (different animal, shared word only) so the daily audit never re-flags them; (3) separately, meal-prep vocabulary has no 'chicken tenderloin' row (nearest is Pork Tenderloin) — a new NAME row is needed via the sanctioned editor, and this ruling does not mint it.
